structured_output.analysis:
The budget is 403/128 = 3.1484 bits per weight, and the best grid, iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e), uses 3.14795. That leaves almost no headroom. Swapping bits between layers looks costly. For the known MLP layers, going from int3 to int2 raises single-layer KL by about 0.02, for example 1.up_proj: rht_gptq_int2 0.0271 (E07ef99eb5de4) against rht_gptq_int3 0.0061 (E0564bc6ad1eb). Upgrades are worth about 0.0035 to 0.0045 each. So pairing one upgrade with one int3-to-int2 downgrade loses KL.

Two cheaper levers are left:
1. Turn on act_order. It does not change the stored bits.
2. Raise the GPTQ weight.group_size from 128 to 256. This roughly halves the per-group overhead, about 0.074 bits per weight across the GPTQ-family layers. That frees bits for 1-bit upgrades of the layers where the loss concentrates.

The upgrades are the 2-bit layers 14.down_proj and 18.gate_proj (to int3), and 27.up_proj, 27.gate_proj, 3.up_proj, 2.up_proj and 1.up_proj (to int4).

proposals.name: iso_actorder
proposals.rationale: Same per-layer methods as iso_3.15 (KL 0.4361, E514ab09c524e) with act_order=true. This changes no stored bits. It isolates whether GPTQ act_order lowers whole-recipe KL.

proposals.name: g256_upgrades_actorder
proposals.rationale:
The upgrades are paid for by setting group_size=256, which shrinks per-group overhead. Single-layer gains measured at default options:
- 27.up_proj: gptq_int3 0.00572 (Ef04d8aa7bded) to gptq_int4 0.00217 (Efea8c18d2abc).
- 27.gate_proj: rht_gptq_int3 0.00499 (Efa0bb391da67) to rht_gptq_int4 0.00153 (Ef428ac081334).
- 3.up_proj: 0.00642 (E6f4f7ea296d5) to 0.00238 (Ef4ee8cb4969e).
- 2.up_proj: 0.00642 (E9baa10763ebe) to 0.00237 (Ef3d9c7b4502c).
- 1.up_proj: 0.00611 (E0564bc6ad1eb) to 0.00227 (E779bc065b72e).
- 14.down_proj: rht_gptq_int2 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065) to rht_gptq_int3 0.00181 (E90bd4b2f3645).
- 18.gate_proj: rht_gptq_int2 KL-minus-floor 0.00497 (Eb1dd74cd6447).
act_order=true is enabled to offset the coarser groups. Base: iso_3.15 (E514ab09c524e).

proposals.name: g256_upgrades
proposals.rationale: Same as g256_upgrades_actorder but without act_order, to separate the effect of group_size=256 plus the upgrades. Example gains: 27.up_proj gptq_int3 0.00572 (Ef04d8aa7bded) to gptq_int4 0.00217 (Efea8c18d2abc); 14.down_proj rht_gptq_int2 0.00633 (E4c3f9b73e065) to rht_gptq_int3 0.00181 (E90bd4b2f3645). Base KL: 0.4361 (E514ab09c524e).
